description: Implement an automated release process that publishes updated packages to npm when changes are merged. The system should handle version bumps, changelog updates, and coordinated publishing across multiple packages in the monorepo.
functional_requirements: Automatically update package.json versions across all affected packages when changes are merged
Generate and update CHANGELOG.md files with release notes for each package
Publish updated packages to npm registry upon merge completion
Handle dependency updates across packages when internal dependencies change
Support coordinated releases where multiple packages are published together
Maintain a changeset tracking system to accumulate changes until release is ready
